title: BunkPro — Dark splash background + updated logo with no purple flash

requirements.summary: Force the splash overlay to use a solid dark background (#0D0D0D) independent of Tailwind theme variables to eliminate any purple/pink tint.
acceptanceCriteria: On cold load and hard refresh, the splash overlay background is a solid dark color (no gradient) and never appears purple/pink at any moment.
The splash overlay does not use `bg-background` (or any CSS variable-driven background) in a way that can tint the background purple/pink in dark mode.
The splash remains full-screen and does not alter app initialization or loading timing/logic.

file_operations.description: Replace the splash overlay background styling so it is a fixed, solid #0D0D0D (avoid bg-background / CSS variables), ensuring full-screen coverage via fixed inset layout while keeping existing initialization behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Prevent pre-React purple/pink flash by setting initial document background to #0D0D0D and adding matching browser theme-color metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Before React mounts (and before any theme classes are applied), the page background is already solid dark and does not flash purple/pink.
`frontend/index.html` includes an explicit `meta name="theme-color"` set to the same solid dark color used for the splash.
No changes are made that affect app bootstrapping logic; only initial/background styling and metadata are adjusted.

file_operations.description: Add `meta name="theme-color"` with content #0D0D0D and set an explicit initial background for the document (e.g., inline style for html/body) so the page is dark before React/Tailwind/theme classes apply.

Add/adjust global base styles for `html, body` to ensure a solid #0D0D0D fallback background that does not rely on theme CSS variables, while allowing the app theme styling to take over after mount as intended.

requirements.summary: Swap the splash logo to the uploaded finalized logo asset and make BRANDING.getAppIcon resolve to it for both dark and light modes.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/assets/generated/Bunkpro.logo_dark_mode.png` exists and is served by the app.
The splash screen image source resolves to `Bunkpro.logo_dark_mode.png` (not the previous `bunkpro-app-icon-*.png` assets).
The splash logo renders with `object-contain` (no stretching/distortion) and remains crisp on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Add the uploaded finalized logo artwork as a static asset at this exact path so it can be used as the single splash/logo source of truth.

Update `BRANDING.getAppIcon(...)` to always return `/assets/generated/Bunkpro.logo_dark_mode.dim_1024x1024.png` for both dark and light modes to avoid mismatches and ensure the splash uses the new logo.
Ensure the splash logo `img` uses `BRANDING.getAppIcon(...)` (now pointing at the uploaded asset) and keeps `object-contain` with responsive sizing for crisp rendering across mobile/desktop.

requirements.summary: Make the splash layout minimal and perfectly centered with a flex full-viewport container and responsive logo scaling.
acceptanceCriteria: The splash overlay centers the logo both horizontally and vertically and occupies the full viewport height (100vh / fixed inset equivalent).
The logo remains centered and appropriately sized across common breakpoints (small phones to desktop) with no cropping or distortion.
Only visual/layout changes are applied to the splash; loading/initialization behavior remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Refine the splash container and inner layout to be a clean, minimal centered presentation (flex center, full-viewport, no unintended padding/margins) and adjust logo sizing rules to scale responsively without distortion.

requirements.summary: Eliminate stale references to old splash assets and ensure the updated logo/background are the single source of truth for splash branding to reduce caching issues after refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: There are no remaining references in the codebase to the old splash icon assets for the splash screen rendering path.
A hard refresh shows the new logo and dark splash background consistently (no intermittent fallback to old logo).
No new service worker is added; if a service worker exists in the project, its caching behavior does not cause the old splash assets/colors to persist.

file_operations.description: Remove/replace any remaining references in splash branding selection to the old `bunkpro-app-icon-*.png` assets so the splash logo path is a single stable value pointing to `/assets/generated/Bunkpro.logo_dark_mode.dim_1024x1024.png`.
Verify the splash rendering path cannot fall back to any old app-icon assets and continues to use the forced dark background; keep all loading/initialization timing and logic unchanged.
